🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM TO US: 'THEY COME FOR SOME, THEN OTHERS'</u>

From the Monumento a la Revolución on her two-year accountability rally — replicated in 32 states — Sheinbaum drew a sharp line: it isn't Trump driving the interference campaign against Mexico, but US 'ultraderecha' sectors positioning for their 2026 midterms and trying to influence Mexico's 2027 vote. She invoked history's warning: 'vienen por unos, luego por otros.' And rebuked the Mexican right that 'celebrates foreign pressure' — including the faction that hosted Spanish far-right pilgrims to honor Hernán Cortés in Madrid. 'Cuando desde fuera se dicta quién es culpable y quién no… ya no hablamos de cooperación, hablamos de injerencia.'

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CNTE TAKES THE ZÓCALO: 'IT'S THE PEOPLE'S, NOT FIFA'S'</u>

Tens of thousands of CNTE teachers launched their indefinite national strike today, marching from the Ángel to the Zócalo and setting up camp in Mexico's main plaza. Demands: repeal the 2007 ISSSTE Law, kill the 2019 education reform, end Afores, raise wages, expand education and health budgets. Their warning to FIFA: 'si no hay solución, no rodará el balón' — no deal, no World Cup ball. Strike hits 10 states: Chiapas, CDMX, Guerrero, Michoacán, Oaxaca, Veracruz, Zacatecas, Yucatán, Baja California, Hidalgo. Mexican labor militancy refusing to be choreographed off the public square for a corporate spectacle.

U.S. MEDIA SILENCE: Plan México turns 1 — and Washington pretends it doesn't exist
May 25 – June 1, 2026 | 🟢

📰 What no major US outlet covered this week, despite filing on Mexico every other day:
• Plan México hit its 1-year anniversary on May 31 — domestic content in export-oriented manufacturing already climbed from 42.6% to 44.2%
• EU pledged $5.8B in fresh Mexico investments aligned with Plan México
• Mexico closed 2025 with a record US trade surplus 20% larger than 2024 — during the year of "tariff tension"
• Sheinbaum announced US and Mexico are near agreement on 54 of the bilateral trade barriers

🇲🇽 NYT, WaPo, WSJ, CNN: zero. The story of a Mexican economic model that's working through tariffs, deepening ties beyond Washington, and re-shoring supply chains — doesn't fit the "Sheinbaum failing under pressure" frame.

CNN: "How dangerous is watching the World Cup in Mexico, really?"
May 31, 2026 | 🟡

📰 CNN spent the article cataloguing which cartel runs which host city — Jalisco "most concerning" because CJNG — then buried the experts saying tourists will mostly face "petty theft, fraud, and opportunistic crimes" and "nothing related to criminal control." Plan Kukulkan, the federal/state/US/Canada joint security plan, got one paragraph.

🇲🇽 Same outlet does not file "How dangerous is Texas, really?" before US host cities with comparable homicide rates.

• Guadalajara is "most concerning" because of one cartel's "grip"
• Tourists face "petty theft, fraud, and opportunistic crimes"

AP/AA WIRE: "'Mexico is not anyone's piñata,' president sends message to Trump in annual address"
June 1, 2026 | 🟢

📰 The wire ran Sheinbaum's two-year anniversary speech at the Monumento a la Revolución uncut. Quotes survived: that the US far right escalated after the April 19 CIA Chihuahua deaths and is now driving the disinfo campaign through "algorithms, paid bots, and fake accounts." She asked whether the target is the 2026 US midterms or Mexico's 2027 elections.

🇲🇽 Note when a wire desk lets the actual question — who pays for the bots — make it past the editors. Rare.

• "Mexico is not anyone's piñata"
• "We do not accept interference"
• Conservatives "are positioning themselves ahead of the 2026 U.S. elections"

FORTUNE/BLOOMBERG: "Sheinbaum Accuses US of Interfering in Mexico's Politics"
May 31, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Fortune ran the wire mostly straight — Sheinbaum's strongest pushback yet over the DOJ indicting Sinaloa's sitting governor Rocha Moya and 9 other officials. She drew the line between cooperation and interference. No US official is quoted to respond.

🇲🇽 What Fortune omitted: Mexico's Attorney General's Office already said the US extradition request lacked "sufficient evidentiary elements." First time Washington has demanded the arrest of a sitting elected Mexican governor — a precedent the article doesn't name.

• "Who decides in Mexico? Foreign agents or the people?"
• "An incident of this magnitude is unprecedented in our bilateral relation"
• "When pressure is applied to our institutions from outside…we're talking about interference"

FORBES: "Mexico's Claudia Sheinbaum Cruelly Acts Like The U.S. Is A Neighbor"
June 1, 2026 | 🤡

📰 John Tamny's grievance, no joke: Sheinbaum denied Sempra's Sinaloa LNG terminal and cancelled Royal Caribbean's $1B Mahahual cruise port. Mexico choosing what gets built on its own coast is now "cruelty" toward the United States.

🇲🇽 What Forbes leaves out: Mahahual borders the second-largest reef on the planet. The Sempra LNG was opposed by Sinaloa communities for years. The columnist's actual complaint is that Mexicans get a vote.

• Sheinbaum acts "cruelly" by treating U.S. like a neighbor
• Mexican presidents "operate fully aware that the U.S. economy will always protect them from themselves"

🇲🇽📉 MEXICAN INFLATION COOLS TO 4.11% — ENERGY PRICES DROP 1.64% AS CFE SUMMER TARIFFS KICK IN

INEGI: annual inflation eased to 4.11% in the first half of May 2026, down from 4.45% at April's close. The non-core index fell 1.14% biweekly, driven by a 1.64% drop in energy and government-authorized tariffs — including CFE's summer electricity adjustments across 11 cities. Core inflation steady at 4.22%. Banxico is holding its policy rate "por cierto tiempo" to anchor the path toward its 3% target by mid-2027. While US PCE inflation hit a 3-year high of 3.8% and Powell's Fed gets squeezed by Trump, Mexico's monetary sovereignty plays out: disinflation without the social wreckage of a shock cycle.

Source: El Economista / INEGI

🇲🇽⚽ MEXICO'S FINTECH HARDENS FOR WORLD CUP — MERCADO PAGO LAUNCHES "ARMORED MODE"

Mercado Pago rolled out Modo Blindado ahead of the 2026 World Cup: geolocated safe-zone authentication, hidden balances and reduced transfer limits outside trusted networks, real-time fraud algorithms monitoring thousands of variables per second. Spokesperson Ramiro Nández: "Queremos que nuestros usuarios salgan con la certeza de que, pase lo que pase, su dinero está siempre protegido." 7 of 10 surveyed users said they'd activate immediately. Mexico is hosting the inauguration plus 13 World Cup matches — and its private financial infrastructure is preparing harder than the gringo press is willing to admit.

Source: regeneracion.mx

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM: TWO FOREIGN AGENTS DIED IN UNAUTHORIZED FIELD OP IN CHIHUAHUA

Not persecution — sovereignty. The Maru Campos investigation centers on the April 19 drug-lab raid in Sierra Tarahumara that left four dead: two state prosecutors and two foreign agents whose presence on Mexican soil was never authorized. Sheinbaum: "¿Por qué había dos personas extranjeras en una operación en campo? Se colabora y se coordina, pero no puede haber operativos en tierra conjuntos." Mexican law requires foreign agents to register with SRE and bars joint field operations. Ex-Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui already resigned. The FGR wants to know who authorized US boots on Mexican ground.

Source: contralinea.com.mx
